text:
li: heads-up: saw a telemetry privacy gap in the sampleapp when running auth+retry combo. some debug/info logs show unhashed email in staging.

devon: yikes. which SDK and env? node or python? enabled OTEL?

li: node sampleapp, latest quickstart from repo, OTEL enabled via REDWOOD_OTEL=1, auth middleware that decorates req.user.email, then retry wrapper. logs at info level have the email in `req.body` output even though we have redaction enabled.

marta: can you paste middleware order? redaction runs as an express middleware (post-body parse) right?

li: order is: authMiddleware -> otel.init() -> loggingMiddleware -> retryWrapper -> routes. redaction hook is inside loggingMiddleware but it only scrubs fields by key name; because auth adds user.email into req.scope during authMiddleware, the logging snapshot includes it before redaction runs.

devon: so redaction runs after the logging snapshot; also OTEL tracer creates a span that has attributes copying request snapshot which includes email. two issues: logging snapshot timing and OTEL attribute population.

qa-labs: repro steps we used: run 10 parallel requests with different users, inspect staging logs at info. email appears in two places: plain log message and span attribute `http.request.body`.

marta: quick patch: move loggingMiddleware (which takes snapshot) after redaction or run redaction as a separate pre-logging hook. but OTEL span attr copy is still a problem unless we delay span attribute set or filter attributes.

devon: agree. recommended fixes:
- generate X-Req-Id as earliest middleware (first thing) so traces/logs can reference same id
- run redaction/scrub middleware immediately after body parse and before any snapshot/span attribute copy
- update OTEL exporter config to filter personal data attributes (attribute processor)

li: i'll try reordering locally.

marta: for parity note: python quickstart already runs reqid -> redaction -> logging order, so this is a node-only regression from recent scaffolding change. we should sync scaffolding templates.

ops-bot: rolling patch build queued for branch `li/telemetry-redact-346` - build 612. staging deploy ETA ~4m. :gear:

devon: also add a unit test in sampleapp that asserts no email-like strings in emitted logs/spans for a synthetic request. cheap guardrail.

qa-labs: filing issue 4892 with logs and repro gist: https://redwood-internal/issue/4892. assigning to eng-platform + devex.

marta: i'll update the onboarding guide to recommend reqid-first, redact-second ordering and link the issue. add a note about setting log level to DEBUG in dev only — we shouldn't have info logs with bodies in prod.

li: patch applied locally, re-tested: no emails in logs when redaction moved earlier. will push PR now. thanks all. :thumbsup:
